headline.text: IFUTSVM-ID (corrected) does not beat the simple imbalance-aware baselines under the shared tuning protocol on these datasets. Equal-weight hold-out balanced accuracy over 12 datasets: IFUTSVM-ID (corrected) 80.7%, SVM (balanced) 83.0%, SMOTE + SVM 84.0%, IFUTSVM-ID (published code) 74.3%.
headline.scope: Descriptive equal-weight means on the predeclared complete twelve-task benchmark; no universal superiority claim.

literature.scope: Only the pre-specified twelve datasets; these subset means are not the paper full-table means.
comparability: Published single random 70/30 split; indices, seed and full preprocessing unavailable.
Our main comparison uses repeated stratified holdout and nested CV with training-only tuning.
Raw Abalone has a nominal feature beyond the published feature count; the difference is retained.
Published ACC is not paired with our runs; no across-protocol significance or fair-ranking claim.
SVM and TSVM do not have columns in Table S.II; their published values are unavailable here.

illustration.selection: First dataset in the pre-specified list, seed zero; deterministic illustration rule, not a best-run selection.

plan.selection: None: default parameters are illustrative; curves never select a main comparison model.
plan.dataset_rule: First dataset in the pre-specified list, not selected for favorable curves.
plan.split_rule: Only outer training rows; three stratified validation folds. Learning subsets use nested class-stratified prefixes within each training fold.
plan.uncertainty: Mean and sample SD over validation folds; SD is descriptive fold variation, not a confidence interval.

learning.rule: Nested stratified prefixes inside each inner training fold; no original outer test rows. Parameters are those already selected by balanced-accuracy inner CV on the original outer training set.

validation.rule: Vary one parameter; all others fixed at the original training-selected values. Descriptive curves, no new selection.

plan.limitation: Curve parameters reuse original inner selection: validation curves are descriptive and not an unbiased generalization estimate. Outer tests remain excluded.

artifact_plan.representative_rule: Sort by full-data imbalance ratio then name; select minimum, lower median, maximum. No prediction or model metric is used.
artifact_plan.roc: For each representative dataset, use all main models, seed zero, persisted minority-positive scores.
artifact_plan.confusion: Sum all five holdout confusion matrices on each representative dataset; paper versus the baseline with greatest equal-weight holdout balanced accuracy on all twelve datasets. Descriptive comparison, not deployment selection.

notebook.dataset_rule: Fewest rows, then name; no performance criterion.
notebook.rule: Execute all five outer splits of each protocol and inner tuning in a fresh temporary output inside the notebook; never reuse fitted caches. Full comparison comes from saved results.

family_sensitivity.reason: Ecoli and yeast derived tasks share a source family, so the required twelve-task analysis need not contain twelve independent datasets. This sensitivity gives each source family equal weight.

main_statistics.omnibus_families: Each predeclared protocol/metric has a separate omnibus and Nemenyi family; no global across-outcome significance claim.

plan.design: One-factor ablations around random_average and conditional_gaussian; not a factorial interaction study.
plan.code_rule: Published spaced pairs, padding and internal U resampling; all other paper components fixed. Actual code U count retained.
plan.generator_hyperparameters: None tuned; numerical covariance ridge fixed at 1e-8.
plan.failure_policy: Failed inner fit consumes candidate; rank valid candidates on training CV only. Outer evaluation failure never triggers reselection.
plan.noise_selection: Fixed coverage of nominal/high-IR, small high-IR, small low-IR, larger low-IR, larger moderate-IR data; not selected on strategy outcomes.
plan.noise_rule: Flip floor(rate*n_outer_train) rows from a fixed random permutation, shared by models; nested inner validation sees the noisy training labels. Outer test labels always clean.
plan.comparison: Paired seed differences against random_average; mean/std over five seeds. Dataset means are the units for across-dataset tests.
plan.theory: Original refuted synthetic prediction retained. KEEL transfer and IR relation are external-validity evidence, not a retrospective replacement hypothesis.
